summary_en: Originate, price and service real estate debt.
summary_fr: Monter, tarifer et gérer le crédit immobilier.

tools.name: Blend
tools.positioning: The borrower-facing front end a bank puts in front of its origination system.
tools.description: Blend provides digital application experiences for mortgage, home equity and consumer lending: guided borrower application, automated asset, income and employment verification, document collection, status tracking and loan officer tooling, integrated into the lender's origination system.
tools.real_estate_use: The failure point in mortgage is the borrower experience: a form that asks for two years of bank statements as PDFs loses applicants to a competitor. Blend replaces that with direct connections to payroll and bank data, so verification happens in the application instead of three weeks later, and the loan officer sees a complete file sooner.
features: Guided digital mortgage and home equity applications
Automated asset, income and employment verification
Document collection with borrower status tracking
Loan officer workspace and pipeline visibility
Integration with origination systems and pricing engines

use_cases.job: Reduce application abandonment with verified data instead of document uploads
Give borrowers a live status view instead of a phone call for every update

tools.name: Encompass
tools.positioning: The loan origination system a large share of US mortgages are actually manufactured in.
tools.description: Encompass is a loan origination system covering the mortgage lifecycle: application intake, processing, underwriting, closing document generation, compliance testing and delivery to investors, with a configuration and partner ecosystem around it.
tools.real_estate_use: A residential mortgage is a regulated manufacturing process — disclosure timing, fee tolerance, appraisal ordering, TRID compliance — where a missed deadline is a legal defect, not an inconvenience. Encompass encodes those rules in the workflow, which is why it sits at the centre of most lender operations and why the whole vendor ecosystem integrates with it.
features: End-to-end loan origination workflow from application to funding
Automated compliance testing including TRID and disclosure timing
Investor delivery and secondary market handoff

use_cases.job: Manufacture a compliant residential loan file from application to funding
Deliver closed loans to investors without re-keying the file

tools.name: Floify
tools.positioning: Document collection and borrower communication for the individual loan originator, not the enterprise.
tools.description: Floify is a mortgage point-of-sale and document portal: borrower application intake, secure document collection with automated chasing, milestone notifications to all parties, and loan officer pipeline tools, sold at a price an individual originator can carry.
tools.real_estate_use: Most of a loan officer's day is chasing paperwork and telling agents where the file stands. Floify automates both — it requests missing documents until they arrive, and notifies the borrower and both agents at each milestone. For a small brokerage or an independent originator it replaces the enterprise point-of-sale they cannot buy.
features: Borrower document portal with automated follow-up requests
Loan application intake and 1003 form handling
Milestone notifications to borrower, agents and partners
Loan officer pipeline and task management
Integration with origination systems and credit providers

use_cases.job: Stop chasing borrower documents manually on every file
See loan milestone status without calling the loan officer
